subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: do you know me yes i know you from my childhood whats your name my name is sumer Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: Capitalization and punctuation "Do you know me?" "Yes, I know you from my childhood." "What's your name?" "My name is Sumer." Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 217
